skyzh.options.title: SkyZH Settings
skyzh.option.enabled.tooltip: Whether the mod translates anything at all.
skyzh.option.translateSkyBlockName.toolt: Translate the game mode name SkyBlock as 空岛生存.
skyzh.option.showOriginal.tooltip: Show the original English after some elements, so items can still be searched for by name inside a GUI.
skyzh.option.captureUntranslated.tooltip: Records untranslated text and mistranslations to a file in the game directory as they are found. Leave this off unless you are a developer.
